name: Abishai
role: Joab's brother, one of David's mighty men
whenBasis: In David's reign, ≈1010–970 BC, counted back from Solomon as Thiele and most chronologies do.
summary: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab and Asahel, chief of the Three among David's mighty men. He went down with David into Saul's camp at night and wanted to pin Saul to the ground with his own spear. He offered to cut off Shimei's head for cursing David, commanded a third of the army against Absalom, and saved David's life from the giant Ishbi-benob.
body: David restrains him twice: from killing the LORD's anointed in the camp, and from killing Shimei: “What have I to do with you, O sons of Zeruiah?”

He killed three hundred men with his spear, and struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt. When David, grown weary in battle, is about to be killed by Ishbi-benob, Abishai comes to his aid, and David's men swear he will not go out to battle again.

moments.text: “Let me go over and cut off his head!”
Commands a third of the army

media.caption: Abishai saves David's life (2 Samuel 21:17), Gustave Doré, 1866.
